description: Compact local model configuration for 16GB-24GB RAM laptops and desktops
hardware_target: Apple Silicon (16GB-24GB) or Linux/Windows with 16GB-24GB VRAM/RAM

rationale.Formalist_Engineer_Auditor: 12B model shared across formalization, coding, and auditing stages to eliminate model swaps while staying under 10GB VRAM.
rationale.Researcher: E4B model provides fast literature synthesis and direct RESEARCH.md + manifest.json authoring.
rationale.Facet_Orchestrator_Scribe: E2B model shared across transient hypervisor seal gating (@Facet), low-latency coordination (@Orchestrator), and ~150M-encoder Stage 0V Vision/PDF OCR (@Scribe) to avoid E2B<->E4B runner thrashing on 16GB-24GB machines.
